messages:
Ivy: Putting up a compact one-pager draft called 'IgniteDeploy' 1 focused on enterprise security, SLAs, and deploy-mode decisioning. Need quick sign-off on hero stat, webinar blurb, and inbound routing tags. Link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/ignitedeploy (internal).

Carlos: Love it. Quick ask: pick one measurable stat for the hero. Field prefers a conservative percent.

Mei: Recommend: "~38% lower inference cost and ~28% improved 95th-pct latency in Dedicated+cache runs". Keeps it defensible and punchy.

Drew: Benchmarks ran on Dedicated pools with KV caching and 4-bit quantization. I'll attach a small table and two PNGs to the brief.

Ivy: For SLAs the copy should be explicit: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): negotiable contractual SLA; Hosted: regional redundancy + automatic fallback." Short and clear.

Carlos: Routing snippet for ops intake (please format into their YAML):
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","IgniteDeploy","secure-inference","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA","eval-kit"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "include compliance needs, sample workload, and latency targets"
```

Mei: Add a quick-filter tag 'nda-needed' for regulated/private conversations and 'eval-kit' for hands-on requests.

Drew: Webinar headline (short): "IgniteDeploy: predictable, secure inference at scale". Blurb: "40-minute deep dive: architecture & SLA patterns, benchmark stories, and a live walkthrough of our evaluation kit. Bring your workload for a custom ops report. Q&A with product + field." Agenda bullets: 1) secure serving patterns 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) evaluation kit walkthrough + next steps.

Ivy: Social post (short): "New brief: IgniteDeploy 1 cut inference costs and meet SLAs for regulated apps. Register for the webinar: [link + UTM]" Keep it punchy and include the CTA to request an evaluation.

Carlos: Field ask: include a 1-line sales play in the appendix: discovery checklist (workload profile, throughput target, compliance needs), suggested pricing appendix, and next steps for demos.

ops-bot: Webinar slot requested: 2026-06-10 11:00 PT 1 request ID 6210.

Ivy: Great. If no objections I'll publish the internal brief tomorrow AM and hand the routing YAML to ops. Owners: copy (Mei), benchmarks (Drew), routing handoff (Carlos), webinar comms (Ivy). :white_check_mark:
